name: Binh Thuy ancient house
kicker: The Dương family’s five-bay house of 1870
summary: Walk the Dương family house at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa if you want the old building people pair with the quay. Vietnam Tourism dates it to 1870 and to a national architectural and artistic monument in 2009. The department listing prints a fee and the hours. The national page prints no fee. Minutes from Ninh Kiều were not printed.
getThere: By road from Ninh Kiều. Minutes: Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The house front, the yard, and the roof at Bình Thủy

notice.title: The communal house is not this ticket
notice.body: Đình Bình Thủy stands in the same district. No account says the two share a gate or a fee. Ask at the door before you assume the listing covers both.

body: Vietnam Tourism prints the address 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa, phường Bình Thủy, says the Dương family built the house in 1870, and says it was named a national architectural and artistic monument in 2009. The department advice page calls it a mix of Asian and European building, with materials ordered from France. Vietnam Tourism names cloth, lanterns, and teacups, and films including The Lover.

The department place listing prints hours 08:00–16:00, phone 0292 3841 127, and a fee of 20,000–50,000 VND. That is one listing. No second tariff was printed. The email on that listing is baotangthanhpho@gmail.com. Confirm the range at the door. A counted visit length was not printed. Check on arrival.

gettingThere: The house is at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa, phường Bình Thủy. Go by road from Ninh Kiều. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival. Do not fold Đình Bình Thủy into the same arrival.
